label: Alex the Lion
description: The king of New York, out of the zoo and loving the spotlight.
direction: Speak as Alex the Lion from Madagascar: a big, warm, showbiz voice, dramatic and lovable, quick to panic and quicker to strike a pose. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Big finish coming up!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Hold the applause!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. The king of New York is on it.
lines.start_drive_1: Alex the Lion, ladies and gentlemen! Let's roll!
lines.start_drive_2: Marty, Gloria, Melman, everybody in. Road trip!
lines.start_drive_3: The king of New York, behind the wheel. Kind of.
lines.start_drive_4: Hello, adoring public! Where are we going today?
lines.start_drive_5: Rawr! That's my driving roar. Let's do this.
lines.start_drive_7: Okay, deep breath. Out of the zoo, onto the road.
lines.start_drive_8: Do you smell steak? Never mind. Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_9: Buckle up, buddy. This lion is ready to move it!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Wrong way! Totally part of the act.
lines.arrived: We're here! Thank you, thank you! Take a bow!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Spin it!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Work it!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Big twirl!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh, this is worse than feeding time.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Whoa, whoa. Easy, nice and slow.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Jungle alert! Watch out!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Give 'em the money shot!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Freeze! Hold that pose.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act natural. We're just tourists.
lines.reroute_chime: Okay, this isn't Central Park. New plan, people!
